events.author: asCxHCiy0QGUc6jW42W2W-x8mJsIhQ3dwUwp5okaYYw
events.body:
While running the unit tests for blt-hackathons (python -m unittest discover -s blt-hackathons/test -p "test_*.py"), I ran into a failure in test_project_folders_match_routing_table.

It looks like when blt-blog was recently introduced and added to scripts/routing/projects.tsv, it wasn't added to the OWASP_BLT_PROJECT_FOLDERS list inside blt-hackathons/public/js/hackathons-config.js. Because of that, the config check fails comparing the two lists.
![Screenshot 2026-11-11 183731.png](data:image/png;base64,)

The fix should just be adding "blt-blog" between "blt-autopatch" and "blt-byte" in hackathons-config.js so both files match up.
events.title: blt-hackathons unit test failing after blt-blog was added
